description: Accepts, declines or tentatively accepts an invitation to a scheduled call for the authenticated user. For a recurring call, scope and occurrence_start_time pick the occurrences the answer is for: all of them (the default), one, or one and every one after it.

occurrence_start_time.description: Start of the occurrence that scope this or this_and_following refers to (RFC 3339).
